text: Citigroup is a NYSE-listed bank with no state ownership (largest holders are institutional investors under 10% each); it paid a $217,841 OFAC settlement in 2014 over Iran-related sanctions violations (not Sudan, Libya, or Burma).

source.name: Citigroup DEF 14A 2026
source.quote: BlackRock and Vanguard each reported that they beneficially owned 5% or more of the outstanding shares of Citi's common stock

additionalSources.name: U.S. Department of the Treasury, OFAC — 'Citigroup Inc. Settles Potential Civil Liability for Apparent Violations of Multiple Sanctions Programs'
additionalSources.quote: Citigroup Inc. (Citigroup), New York, New York, has agreed to remit $217,841 to settle potential civil liability for eight apparent violations of the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations
